verdict.rationale: Statsig explicitly ships 'Dynamic Configs' alongside Feature Gates and Experiments, referenced across CLI, HTTP API, and SDK docs (statsig-docs-9, statsig-docs-10, statsig-docs-41), and experiments support multiple variants beyond simple booleans (statsig-docs-33, statsig-docs-30 Layers). This confirms multivariate/dynamic config capability, though the evidence never explicitly enumerates the exact value types (string/number/JSON) or shows a config payload example. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of supported dynamic-config value types (JSON/string/number) and a concrete SDK code sample retrieving a typed config value.
